stepTitle: Which corrected expression should be assigned on the first line?
stepBody:
The name of the player with less than 10,000 aces who has played the most matches in their career.
$$	exttt{less\_aces\_players}$$ $$=$$ tennis.where("Num. Aces", are.below("10000"))
$$	exttt{less\_aces\_most\_matches}$$ $$=$$ $$	exttt{less\_aces\_players.sort("Matches}$$ Played", $$descending=True).column("Name").item(0)$$
UFuncTypeError: ufunc 'less' did not contain a loop with signature matching types (<class 'numpy.dtypes.Int64DType'>, <class 'numpy.dtypes.StrDType'>) -> None
